name: The Atlas Has No Last Page - Legacy Commendation
description:
Sera binds nine legendary expedition records into a volume beside the longer provincial chronicle. Some of these victories also serve Book II; the ledger honors them without demanding a second kill.

Complete the nine legacy records, then enter "leave a page for tomorrow". This is an optional commendation. The expanded main ending is The Unwritten Kingdoms in Book II.
